fused compound accusative form; internal sandhi before mūla

items.question: What is declared to be the root Kaula connected with eight siddhi attainments?
premises: Root Kaula is linked to them.
items.inference: The verse identifies root Kaula with eight siddhi attainments.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation of ca remains unclear.
items.plain_english: Eight, and the root Kaula of siddhi-attainment, O fair-faced one.
